title: Data-Driven Static Output-Feedback Control for Multi-Agent Systems
summary: This work proposes a data-driven framework that synthesizes output-feedback control for linear time-invariant multi-agent systems (MAS). We first develop two algorithms that use offline data samples of state and input trajectories to determine a Nash equilibrium (NE) for MAS. Next, we formulate a semidefinite program that, given the NE solution, computes the static output-feedback controllers for the agents in MAS.
